description:
Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI.

Modern, lightweight and multi-cluster Kubernetes GUI. Available on Windows, macOS and Linux.
Features:
- 💯 Connect to one or more clusters simultaneously
- ⚡️ Aggregated Log Viewer
- ⚖️ Resource Diff
- ✌️ Multi-Namespace Selector
- 💪 Human-friendly resource view
- ✍️ View & modify objects
- 🎉 Zero-config setup
- 😉 NOT another Electron app
- ✅ Works with any Kubernetes cluster: on-prem, GKE, EKS, AKS and others.
- 💻 Available on Windows, macOS and Linux
✨ New
- VPA: Added VPA (Vertical Pod Autoscaler) as a first-class resource in Aptakube, giving you a much clearer view on its recommended resources for matching pods.
- Helm: Added shortcuts to Upgrade (U) and Rollback (R)
- Helm: Upgrade and Rollback now happen on the background, with the status reported on a persistent notification. Upgrade actions can be cancelled.
- Helm: Redesigned the Rollback modal for more clarity and better usability, giving you the option to compare values before start a rollback
- Helm: Helm Releases now have all standard context menu actions, as well as Upgrade and Rollback, to keep the UX consistent with other resources
- Navigation: Added a new browser-link shortcut for "Open In New Tab and Focus".
💎 Improvements
- Helm: When the Helm CLI is not installed, we'll add a link to instructions on how to install it. #396
- Navigation: Added Shift+Click on Switch Context as an option to open a new window on the context selector.
- ArgoCD: Added an optional "Prune" option when performing a sync on an ArgoCD App. #584
🐞 Fixes
- Helm: Helm Releases now show the actual release name, rather than the underlying secret name.
- Navigation: Fixed a bug where Ctrl+Click on the Switch Context would open a browser window.
